_comment: Roster page per school, keyed by the same normalized team name
update-seed.py's norm_team() produces: lower-cased, dots removed,
'state' shortened to 'st'. There is no pattern to athletics domains
(kuathletics.com, goshockers.com, hailstate.com), so this map is written
by hand and confirmed by the scrape log rather than guessed at runtime.
A team missing from this map is skipped, never an error. The scrape is a
bonus pass for opposing players' heights; nothing downstream requires it.
Every entry starts in 'unverified' and moves up once a run logs it
parsing. These domains came from the volleyball app's own verified map,
where they were confirmed for /sports/womens-volleyball/roster — the
domain is the hard-won part — but the basketball path is an assumption
until a run proves it. Nothing here has been fetched: this session's
egress proxy refuses athletics sites, so CI is the first real test.
